text: MSBuild error XA1029 in a MAUI Android build is the wrapper, not the cause. The real failure is in obj/Debug/net11.0-android/.../build.log. Nine times out of ten it is one of three things: JAVA_HOME pointed at JDK 11 instead of JDK 17 for AGP 8.x, the maui-android workload was not restored after a .NET SDK bump, or a Windows long-path violation broke the R8 output.
